purpose: Define a MeritCore record as identity-bound evidence derived from an explicit Project/work outcome and recorded by authorized backend semantics rather than self-authored profile content.

topics.name: Merit Record
topics.purpose: Define a MeritCore record as identity-bound evidence derived from an explicit Project/work outcome and recorded by authorized backend semantics rather than self-authored profile content.

semantics.identity_rule: Every merit belongs to exactly one IdentityCore identity.
semantics.project_rule: Merit references the universal Project primitive.
semantics.write_rule: Merit evidence is written through authorized backend operations; profile/UI content cannot mint merit.
semantics.evidence_rule: Merit retains exact evidence/provenance refs supporting the recorded outcome.
semantics.calculation_rule: Raw merit evidence is distinct from points/Tier calculations derived from it.
semantics.merge_rule: Merit records belonging to separate identities cannot be merged into one merit history.

invariants.rule: MeritCore-derived points, Tier, recommendations and trust remain bound to one identity and explicit Project/evidence history; they cannot be manufactured by presentation, identity merging or time-splitting.

hard_gates.condition: merit lacks identity or Project ref
points conflated with raw merit evidence
merit written without authorized backend operation

references.purpose: Portfolio may display merit but cannot mint it.
